items.title: Grupo Consorcio Tops €126m Turnover In Milestone 75th Year
items.summary: Spanish canned-seafood producer Grupo Consorcio generated over €126 million in gross turnover in 2025, its 75th anniversary.

items.title: Kaufland Partners With Naturland To Expand Certified Organic Offer
